newsitem.title: USA: Box, TCI Music to merge.
newsitem.headline: Box, TCI Music to merge.

text.p: Box Worldwide Inc and TCI Music Inc said they have signed a binding letter of intent to merge Box into TCI Music in a deal valued at about $38 million.
The letter of intent calls for each common share of Box to be valued at $1.50 and exchanged for shares of TCI Class A preferred stock.
The companies said the merger is expected to take several months to complete.

The number of TCI preferred shares which each Box holder will be entitled to receive will be determined by dividing the product of $1.50 times the number of Box shares held, by three times the average bid and ask price of TCI common stock during the 20 consecutive trading days ending on the third trading day prior to the closing of the transaction.
Each share of TCI preferred would be immediately convertible into three shares of TCI common.
As a result of the merger, The Box Worldwide will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of TCI Music.
Box Worldwide programs and distributes the music video channel The Box.
TCI Music delivers audio and video music services to residential and commercial customers via television, the Internet and other methods.
